scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,analysis -c cyan,magenta "next dev" "bun run analysis"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n web,analysis -c cyan,magenta "next dev --experimental-https --hostname 0.0.0.0 -p 8080" "bun run analysis"
